propositions: A pure single-pass prepacked verifier yields false-positive rejections when prepack evidence is imperfect; a filter-only (PASS/ABSTAIN, never FAIL) stage followed by narrowed agentic fallback eliminates false-positive rejections by construction.
Coverage is bimodal by AC style: greppable artifacts (symbols, files, test names) achieve 80-90% filter PASS rate; runtime outcomes and store-side artifacts rationally ABSTAIN at 0% PASS rate.

Filter+fallback achieves -26% total input tokens and -46% on real (all-met) tickets versus pure agentic, with filter spend negligible (~0.4%), while maintaining zero false-PASS rate on adversarial unmet ACs.
The 8000-character description admission cap in verify_completion can reject tickets after AC-block reduction; adversarial AC edits must remain length-neutral and the reducer must re-check the cap.

Agentic verifier exhibits 35-55 step variance and occasional low-rate false-FAIL on identical criteria sets, so cost deltas <±30% are noise and the residual risk in production is agentic false-FAIL variance, not filter false-PASS.
